description: This Java source file defines the DBCPConnectionFactory class, which implements a connection factory for Apache Commons DBCP connection pooling within the OFBiz framework. It manages database connection pooling, configuration, and retrieval, including handling transaction integration and connection validation.

classes.name: DBCPConnectionFactory
classes.description: Implements a connection factory for Apache Commons DBCP, managing connection pooling, configuration, and transaction integration within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a database connection from the pool, creating and configuring the pool if necessary, with support for transaction management and connection validation.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Clears the connection pool cache, allowing for garbage collection.

methods.description: Returns information about the data source associated with the given helper name.
